lines.zh: 我走过的土都变成结晶。
lines.en: The soil crystallises where I pass.
My stride is slow but very long.

lines.zh: 晶体在我身体里重新排列。
lines.en: The crystal inside me rearranges.
Every ten steps I change a little.
My shape is still adjusting.
I step and the stone splits.

lines.zh: 我的关节响得像矿层错动。
lines.en: My joints sound like strata shifting.
I walk through the middle of the field.
My shadow falls in several layers.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往有矿的地方走。
lines.en: I head slowly toward the ore.

lines.zh: 我停下来修正了一条腿。
lines.en: I stop to correct one of my legs.
I stand, and I am changing.
Light travels inside my crystal.
These thousand points, I can hold.
I need no food, only ore.
My breath carries powder.
I am regrowing a plate.
The ground nearby trembles faintly.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，也在进化。
lines.en: Even doing nothing, I evolve.
My head turns slowly to the ore field.

lines.zh: 这一副身体太完美，反而空。
lines.en: This perfect body is empty instead.
Do you want to become like this?
You carry no ore; a pity.

lines.zh: 我看你，是在算你值多少。
lines.en: I look at you and reckon your worth.
You are too soft for even one blow.

lines.zh: 你的甲在源石面前是纸。
lines.en: Your armor is paper before originium.

lines.zh: 晶格改造需要很久，我等着。
lines.en: Lattice work takes time; I can wait.
Your hand shakes; that is natural.

lines.zh: 这一带所有的矿都在叫。
lines.en: All the ore here is calling.
I stoop to your eye level.
You are already much too close.
You cut through one layer of crystal.
The crack closes quickly.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地响了一声。
lines.en: I step back and the ground rings.

lines.zh: 疼对我来说是一种数据。
lines.en: Pain is merely data to me.
A layer of crystal has peeled.
You struck harder than I expected.
I lower my head to the wound.
You have a few chances left.
Give me all that ore.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我进化的。
lines.en: That is not enough for my evolution.
I smell pure originium.
The higher you hold it, the more I want it.
I reach out; you should let go.

lines.zh: 这点量，只够我修一只角。
lines.en: Enough for one horn, no more.
I slowly draw it dry.

lines.zh: 你身上源石的味道，压过了恐惧。
lines.en: The originium smell on you outweighs any fear.
You hit me like hitting a mountain.

lines.zh: 这一下让你肩膀错位了吧。
lines.en: That should have dislocated your shoulder.

lines.zh: 晶片从我身上崩了几块。
lines.en: A few shards break off me.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是进化的尽头。
lines.en: This body is evolution's end.
I raise a hand and you are pushed away.
Sparks flew where we struck.
Do not press against my crystal.
You are still whole; good.
Evolution needs no mate.

lines.zh: 我是从矿里长出来的东西。
lines.en: I grew out of the ore.

lines.zh: 这一副身体不适合那种事。
lines.en: This body is unsuited to that.
Your asking shows you do not understand.
I lower my head and a crystal flashes.

lines.zh: 我要的是纯度，不是同类。
lines.en: I want purity, not company.

lines.zh: 没有第二个我，也不需要。
lines.en: There is no second me, and no need.
Move; I am returning to the ore.
That subject means nothing to me.
I draw it into my palm.
It crumbles to powder in my hand.
A small piece; I look it over.
I press it into my chest.
This one has too many impurities.
I squeeze and it shatters.
I hold it up to the light.
It sinks slowly into my hide.
I keep one piece in reserve.
I toss it back into the vein.

lines.zh: 你在这片矿区里太显眼。
lines.en: You stand out too much in this field.
I have fixed your crystallisation point.
I have begun walking this way.
All my crystals have lit.
There is nothing else here.
I have logged your coordinates.
There is not quite enough ore tonight.

lines.zh: 你一踏入矿区，晶脉就醒了。
lines.en: The moment you enter the mine, the crystal veins wake.

lines.zh: 我想看看你被结晶包住的样子。
lines.en: I want to see you encased in crystal.
I raise my crystallised palm.
After this step, you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那些矿，都算你的。
lines.en: The ore you crushed is on your account.
I am patient; let us take our time.
Listen; the ore is humming.
I follow, step by step.
You cross the pit and its walls fall.

lines.zh: 我的每步都在改变地形。
lines.en: Each step of mine reshapes the ground.

lines.zh: 你在矿堆间绕，我看得清。
lines.en: I see you plainly weaving among the heaps.

lines.zh: 结晶从你的脚印里长出来。
lines.en: Crystals grow in your footprints.
I am not fast, but I am growing stronger.

lines.zh: 晶体顺着你的脚印，一寸寸追。
lines.en: Crystals follow your footprints, inch by inch.
You run east, where the ore is thicker.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让晶体再长一层。
lines.en: I stop and let the crystal grow a layer.
Your steps are slowing.
Ore is clumping on your soles.
I am only ten steps away.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，地面开始发光。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the ground begins to glow.
Run further and you will step into the vein.
Both ways are me now.
Do you hear that sound?
I stop so you can look back.
Now, the last few steps.
My hand comes down, heavy.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的盾砸弯了。
lines.en: That bent your shield.

lines.zh: 我从肩膀甩出一片晶刃。
lines.en: I fling a crystal blade from my shoulder.
You blocked, and your arms went numb.
A thousand points. Fully evolved.

lines.zh: 你砍进我的晶体，弹了一下。
lines.en: Your blade strikes my crystal and rebounds.

lines.zh: 我一掌落下，你的护甲长满晶簇。
lines.en: My palm falls and crystals sprout all over your armor.
You are pressed to your knees.
I raise my hand to press again.
Three fresh lines appear on your armor.
I take hold of your weapon.
It bends in my grip.
You tear free and retreat far.
I turn my shoulder back slowly.

lines.zh: 你还有第二次机会，不多。
lines.en: You get one more chance, no more.
This time I will press harder.
I raise both arms and bring them down.
Crystals grow between my fingers.
You have backed to the ore wall.
Good; this one settles it.
I come from the deepest seam.
Crystal first, flesh after.

lines.zh: 这具身体自出生就是完整的。
lines.en: This body was complete from birth.
A thousand from the first day.

lines.zh: 我站定，地就已经矮了一截。
lines.en: I stand, and the ground is already lower.

lines.zh: 空气里的矿粉都朝我聚。
lines.en: The ore dust in the air gathers to me.
I have begun changing on the spot.
The local geology is going unstable.
I raise my eyes and see fire.
Before this I had no name.

lines.zh: 完美的身体，只需要一个目标。
lines.en: A perfect body needs only a target.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，表面发亮。
lines.en: Fire bakes my plates until they shine.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，碎了一角。
lines.en: I crash from a height and break a corner.

lines.zh: 水渗进晶缝，重得不正常。
lines.en: Water seeps into the seams and weighs strangely.
The blast peels off a whole layer.

lines.zh: 箭矢在我甲上碎成了粉。
lines.en: The arrow shatters to powder on my plates.
That force worms into my lattice.
Short on ore, my plates dim.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的晶面到处跑。
lines.en: Lightning runs all across my facets.
I fall into nothing and my crystals ring.
